informal_statement: The declared QLF RAR formula reproduces descriptive residuals on a curated public SPARC sample: 147 galaxies / 2696 points, mean -0.0002 dex and scatter 0.1327 dex at H0=73 and M/L=0.5/0.7. This is a retrospective benchmark, not independently established blinding.

approximation_or_regime.name: non-relativistic equilibrium; canonical M/L; local H0
approximation_or_regime.description: Non-relativistic algebraic RAR with declared H0=73 km/s/Mpc and standard external disk/bulge M/L=0.5/0.7. The QLF formula has no per-galaxy fitted parameter. Vobs is loaded and used for quality selection before sealing.
approximation_or_regime.validity_limits: The benchmark does not establish interpolation uniqueness, historical information isolation, an independent timestamp, statistical model equivalence, or a measured uncertainty floor.

formal_statement.statement_scope: Algebraic identities for the acceleration scale and the closure-balance RAR; not a derivation of the SPARC data or of the interpolation's uniqueness.

formal_object.type: algebraic RAR model plus retrospective public-data pipeline

dependencies.audit_baseline: not present for these theorem names in the 240-anchor baseline at the source revision
dependencies.qlf_bridge_axioms: none explicit in the source scan; original #print axioms output pending

inputs.name: H0
inputs.source: local Hubble constant; SPARC.md states H0 is declared, not fitted

inputs.name: SPARC data
inputs.value: 147 galaxies, 2696 points after Q<=2, Inc>=30 deg, e_Vobs<0.1 Vobs

interpretation.map: The closure-balance relation is identified with the observed radial-acceleration relation; a0 = cH0/(2 pi) is identified with the MOND/RAR acceleration scale.
interpretation.formal_status: The algebraic RAR identity is formalized; the identification of the closure-balance variables with the observed g_bar/g_obs is a bridge, and the interpolation form is not unique.
interpretation.noncircularity_test: For an admitted point the prediction uses baryonic inputs. The sample selection uses Vobs/error ratios; Vobs and gobs are loaded/computed before the seal. A stronger test needs controlled target access and a frozen analysis.

observable.symbol: T = g_obs / g_pred; residual = log10(g_obs) - log10(g_pred)
observable.uncertainties: Descriptive residual scatter only; no independently reanalysed measurement uncertainty budget or intrinsic-scatter inference.

measurement_protocol.status: retrospective public-data reproduction; no new observations
measurement_protocol.design: Apply declared target-informed quality cuts; evaluate a baryonic-input formula; hash predictions before residual scoring. This does not establish a pre-unblinding information barrier.
measurement_protocol.apparatus: SPARC long-slit Halpha rotation curves and 3.6 micron photometry; public data.
measurement_protocol.failure_condition: A reproduced mismatch in the RAR, a failed independent replication, or a dependence on H0/M-L that removes the zero-offset result.

reported_agreement.value: 0.133 dex scatter, mean -0.0002 dex, 147 galaxies / 2696 points
reported_agreement.comparator: SPARC curated sample; Newton and per-galaxy NFW fits on the same points
reported_agreement.uncertainty: Descriptive residual scatter only; no independently reanalysed measurement uncertainty budget or intrinsic-scatter inference.

evidence.F: The algebraic RAR and a0 identities are source-inspected; original theorem-specific #print axioms anchors are absent.
evidence.N: Exact reproduction and digests are recorded in the scoped numerical receipt; no claim of historical blindness follows.
evidence.E: No new observations, controlled blind reveal, or independent physical replication.
evidence.reviewer: Ω-WITNESS technical review for aixaria0; collaborator tier; the receipt records executed checks separately from publication approval.

defeaters.formal: A kernel/axiom discrepancy or a counterexample to the RAR identity.
defeaters.interpretation: The interpolation form is not unique, or the closure-balance variables do not map onto the observed g_bar/g_obs.
defeaters.numerical: An independent pipeline reproduces a different residual distribution or a nonzero mean offset.
defeaters.empirical: A failed independent replication, or a dependence on H0/M-L that removes the result.
defeaters.conceptual: The 'parameter-free' claim is overstated because H0 and M/L are external inputs.
